## What this repo is

In one line: **A downstream fork of jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile whose job is to make the HarmonyOS port run flawlessly on HarmonyOS PC (2in1) and HarmonyOS phones — install, import, play, save, at a stable 60 fps, with touch, keyboard/mouse and gamepad input.**.

- Not doing / boundaries: [`d2r-mobile-positioning.md`](d2r-mobile-positioning.md)
- How trade-offs are decided: [`d2r-mobile-design-philosophy.md`](d2r-mobile-design-philosophy.md)
- Code and data-flow map: [`d2r-mobile-architecture.md`](d2r-mobile-architecture.md)

## Active work

- Huge epic: [HarmonyOS PC + phone, flawless](research/2026-10-26-hmos-flawless/00-epic-sot.md) —
  umbrella [issue 001](issues/001-hmos-flawless-on-pc-and-phone.md); decisions in [ADR-0001](adr/0001-fork-layout-additive-docs-on-main.md).

## Upstream docs in this directory (read-only on our `main`, ADR-0001)

Files in CAPITALS (`*.md` + `*.zh-CN.md`) are upstream's player / developer docs. The ones that
matter here: [`HARMONYOS.md`](HARMONYOS.md) (player guide), [`GAME_FILES.md`](GAME_FILES.md),
[`DEPENDENCIES.md`](DEPENDENCIES.md), [`DERIVED.md`](DERIVED.md) (what derived interface data the
repo may carry), [`ANDROID.md`](ANDROID.md) (the shared Vulkan engine's other shell).
The HarmonyOS developer build is upstream's [`dm/harmony/README.md`](../dm/harmony/README.md).

## The archive

| Directory | What lives here | Index |
|---|---|---|
| `adr/` | **Settled decisions** (including the alternatives rejected at the time). An accepted ADR is immutable: supersede it, never edit it | [adr/README.md](adr/README.md) |
| `issues/` | **Work to do**: one issue per file, a `Status:` line carrying its date, acceptance criteria under `## Exit` | [issues/README.md](issues/README.md) |
| `research/` | **Research**: `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` point-in-time snapshots; a large epic gets a directory plus `00-epic-sot.md` | [research/README.md](research/README.md) |
| `agents/` | **Procedure**: how issues are recorded, how labels are applied, where the glossary lives | see below |

Procedure docs:

- [`agents/issue-tracker.md`](agents/issue-tracker.md) — issue lifecycle, and the split from the ledger
- [`agents/triage-labels.md`](agents/triage-labels.md) — the label set and what each one means
- [`agents/domain.md`](agents/domain.md) — the glossary (`CONTEXT.md`) and the domain conventions

| Role | Order |
|---|---|
